---
name: release
description: Assess ZeroTrace release readiness and prepare a reversible release plan.
---
Use `shipping-and-launch`, `code-review-and-quality`, and `zerotrace-development-loop`. Read Phase 18 gates, prior evidence, CI, dependency/license/security results, measured resource profile, backup/restore and rollback procedures. Verify every claim from actual artifacts; mark gaps BLOCKED. Prepare a checklist and rollback plan only. Do not publish, deploy, scan external assets, spend money, or enable production remediation. Require human approval for any consequential release action.
